text_block_list.text:
—The third year. Various changes were 
beginning to unfold even for BNW, who had 
always seemed immune to summer's decline.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... No good... With 
cardiovascular endurance so poor that I'm 
out of breath from just this...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't prove anything to her. Not with 
superficial formulas!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wah! Brian-senpai, you're too fast!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
With this kind of speed on sand! It feels 
like you've got no blind spots for the 
Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Narita Brian-san... Hayahide-san's 
younger sister from the generation below 
us.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Having conquered the spring Satsuki Sho 
and Japan Derby, all eyes are on them for 
the Classic Triple Crown.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Tch, not enough. One more set.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ghk...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(It's not just the three-way deadlock of 
BNW. Hayahide-san also has the rivalry 
between sisters...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*... Hmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Man... Before it was, like, way more 
intense... Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you out for roadwork too, 
Ticket-san?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Royce. I was, but... I think I'm about 
ready to wrap up.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm just finishing up too. Let's head back 
to the training camp lodge together!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Royce noticed it too, huh. Hayahide's 
on edge, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there was a demonic intensity to it. 
It looks like she's really keeping Brian 
in mind.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, ever since Brian debuted, we've been 
constantly compared to each other...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ever since they were little, it seems like 
Hayahide has always felt she needs to be 
the "older sister" for Brian.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... do you think you have to 
be stronger than your younger sister just 
because you're the older one?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right. That 'Winning Formula' was 
devised specifically to defeat Brian, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Still... you're obsessing over it far too 
much. It's as if you're putting a curse on 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Ah, last year's training camp was 
so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin isn't here this year, and Hayahide 
is acting like that, so...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that the reason Ticket-san's 
spirits are so low? It looks like her 
heart really isn't in her training, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just, like... I'd been aiming for 
the Derby for so long, it was pretty much 
everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Derby's over, this feeling of 
not knowing what to do next has slowly 
started to grow.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, Royce, I...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I wonder what I'm running for...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Identity... Losing the very reason to 
run—huh.
choice_data_list:
Hm? That serious look on your face... 
What's wrong?
Huh? You look so serious... What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer, guess... what!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's heavy! Way too heavy! The problems 
both Hayahide-san and Ticket-san are 
carrying are just too much!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, there's enough here for a full 
drama series... To think they were 
harboring such deep, complex feelings 
inside themselves...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I really... haven't been seeing anything 
at all, have I?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Youth? Friendship? What a joke. How can I 
call myself a producer when I'm this blind 
to what's around me...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Oh, Chitose O-san.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You look rather gloomy. Are you feeling 
unwell again?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
No, my condition has gotten somewhat 
better, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
I was lost in thought for a moment. You 
see, something sad happened at the end of 
last year...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: A sad... event?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Someone I held dear has departed for 
Mount Tai...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how many times I win now, that 
person will never be able to watch me 
again."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how brightly it shines, it 
cannot reach above the clouds. This world 
rarely goes as we wish, does it—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Chitose O-san... Yeah, besides physical 
condition..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Everyone—is alive...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is living their own lives to the 
fullest. Compared to them, I...
choice_data_list: No need to feel down, Royce.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I was being serious in my own 
way too. I was truly aiming to be the 
'strongest.' But..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It felt like I wasn't really capturing the 
hearts of the fans. Like somehow, it just 
wasn't reaching them...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I think I finally understood the reason a 
little this summer. What I've been lacking 
is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: It is one's very "core."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Without searching for it, I simply 
focused solely on making myself look like 
the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It might look like a reckless act. Even 
so...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, you know! Because I 
"knew" it all along.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... I don't really have anything 
special to offer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I don't have it, I just have to fake it 
to get their attention. But if a fake me 
won't reach them...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: What should I... do...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"What should I do? At this rate, no matter 
how many times I redo it, I'll never be 
able to move people's hearts."

I think to myself. Royce and Royce says 
that she "doesn't have anything special," 
but...

"That's not true. In fact, that very 
nature of hers is what drew me in, leading 
us to work together. If so—"
choice_data_list: Channel all those worries into the race.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Worries? You mean turning this hazy 
frustration into running power?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, if we run, we'll surely see 
something.

Yeah, if we run, I'm sure we'll see 
something.

text_block_list.text:
The true feelings of an Umamusume who 
throws herself into racing— are always 
found within the race itself. And—

I felt that by sharing my own troubles 
with the troubled BNW, something might 
just start to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. No matter how many 
strategy meetings we hold, I will always 
end up shaping who I am on my own."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even if we charge in blindly, we might not 
find anything... but it's better than 
doing nothing.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer. Fortunately, there is 
still time until the autumn GⅠ Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to clash with them in the All 
Comers— with everything I've got against 
Hayahide-san and Ticket-san.
